title: feat(ingest): serve OTLP/gRPC on the public ingest endpoint

summaries.body:
## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk medium · 2/2 new units observable Serves OTLP/gRPC on the public ingest endpoint: gzip, the HTTP path's raw and decoded body limits, a request deadline, and an ALB gRPC target group on the 443 listener. The Rust side is well tested and the infra is gated to stages with an HTTPS ingest domain; only the deadline path stays invisible in Maple. - `grpc_router` accepts gzip and caps decoded messages at `INGEST_MAX_DECODED_BODY_BYTES` - `limit_grpc_body` refuses raw bodies past `INGEST_MAX_REQUEST_BODY_BYTES` - Host port 4317 mapped, ALB gRPC target group behind a `/opentelemetry.proto.collector.*` rule - Shutdown now awaits the gRPC server before the WAL drain ### Before merge - [ ] **Infra** · Check every environment has what this config now expects · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/ac3652485952a95d5a2562b4f35e08127ae22b4d/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts) - [ ] **Manual** · Turn on gRPC for the maple.dev (and EU) Cloudflare zone in the dashboard — until then gRPC clients get 403 ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F1 · gRPC deadline cancels the call before its span records an outcome observability · STAT-01 · [`apps/ingest/src/main.rs:3311-3313`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/ac3652485952a95d5a2562b4f35e08127ae22b4d/apps/ingest/src/main.rs#L3311-L3313) `builder.timeout(request_timeout)` is applied outside the axum router, so when the 30s deadline fires the `grpc_admission` future is dropped and `record_grpc_outcome` never runs: the export's span ends with no `rpc.grpc.status_code`, no `maple.ingest.reject_reason`, and `ingest_request_timeouts_total` (`metrics.rs:189`) never moves, although the HTTP path counts and records the same timeout (`main.rs:2068`). A stalled gRPC exporter therefore looks exactly like a successful one in Maple. Enforce the deadline inside `grpc_admission` so the middleware can see it and record `Cancelled` on the span before answering. ``` Drop `builder.timeout` and wrap `next.run(request)` in `tokio::time::timeout(request_timeout, ...)` inside `grpc_admission`: on `Elapsed`, record `rpc.grpc.status_code = 1`, `maple.ingest.reject_reason = "request timed out"` on `span_handle`, call the timeout counter, and return `tonic::Status::cancelled(..).into_http()`. ```
### Production impact
Telemetry this change adds and removes (1) - ➕ attribute `deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds` · `patches/@alchemy.run%2Faws@2.0.0-beta.84.patch:183`
What was checked - `serveGrpc` is gated on `domains.ingest`, so PR previews keep `loadBalancer: true` and no 4317 mapping (`alchemy.run.ts:230`) - The paused (`Drop`) branch swaps in an empty frame before the new limit runs, so a gzip `grpc-encoding` cannot reach tonic (`main.rs:3387`) - New span fields are `rpc.grpc.status_code`, `error.type` and a config-derived size message; no key or payload bytes
Observability coverage: 2 of 2 changes observable | Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | OTLP/gRPC export endpoint on 4317 (via ALB) | server | yes | `grpc_server_span` + `record_grpc_outcome` per call (`main.rs:3378`, `3406`); the deadline path records nothing | | ALB gRPC target group and 443 listener rule | infrastructure | yes | ALB access logs (`logging: { retention: "30 days" }`) and target group health metrics only |
`ac36524` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one. Check ids refer to Maple's instrumentation audit.

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
F1 is fixed and the new gzip, body-cap, single-frame and deadline paths each have a test; the ALB gRPC route itself can only be verified after deploy.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium · 3/3 new units observable</sub>

Adds gzip acceptance, the HTTP path's body caps, an in-admission deadline and a shutdown await to the OTLP/gRPC gateway, behind the ALB gRPC routing. The earlier span-without-outcome defect is fixed and I found no new defects.

- `grpc_router` accepts gzip and caps decoded messages at `INGEST_MAX_DECODED_BODY_BYTES`
- `limit_grpc_body` caps the raw body and refuses a second gRPC frame before tonic decodes it
- Gateway deadline moved inside `grpc_admission`, answering `UNAVAILABLE` and recording the span
- Shutdown awaits the gRPC server before the WAL drain

### Before merge

- [ ] **Infra** · Check every environment has what this config now expects · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/9f613c29e6c1170248c1b7c3c48c1af9e93dbf00/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts) <!-- ms:infra:apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts -->
- [ ] **Manual** · Turn on gRPC for the maple.dev Cloudflare zone (Network → gRPC); until then the host answers 403 <!-- ms:manual:turn-on-grpc-for-the-maple-dev-and-eu-cloudflare-zone-in-the-dashboard-6f301464 -->
- [ ] **Manual** · After the prd deploy, export traces, logs and metrics over gRPC (gzip) to both the US and EU ingest hosts <!-- ms:manual:after-the-prd-deploy-export-traces-logs-and-metrics-over-grpc-gzip-to-b-a9928d10 -->
- [ ] **Manual** · Check `INGEST_MAX_DECODED_BODY_BYTES` (default 8× the raw limit, 160 MiB) fits the ingest task memory <!-- ms:manual:check-ingest-max-decoded-body-bytes-default-8-the-raw-limit-160-mib-fit-e90aabf5 -->

### Fixed since the last review

- ✅ ~~F1 · gRPC deadline cancels the call before its span records an outcome~~

### Production impact

<details><summary>Telemetry this change adds and removes (1)</summary>

- ➕ attribute `deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds` · `patches/@alchemy.run%2Faws@2.0.0-beta.84.patch:183`

</details>

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- F1: deadline now runs inside `grpc_admission` and `record_grpc_outcome` follows it (`main.rs:3402-3419`); `run_grpc_server` keeps no outer timeout
- `SingleGrpcFrame` parses the 5-byte header across chunk boundaries and refuses only bytes past the first frame
- `http_body_util::Limited` wraps the body in place, so `Content-Length` and the size hint still reach tonic; decompressed size stays bounded by `max_decoding_message_size`

</details>

<details><summary>Observability coverage: 3 of 3 changes observable</summary>

| Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OTLP/gRPC export (traces, logs, metrics) | inbound handler | yes | `grpc_server_span` (`otel.rs:294`) recorded by `record_grpc_outcome` (`main.rs:2378`, `main.rs:3419`) |
| gRPC gateway deadline shed | error path | yes | `metrics::request_timed_out` (`main.rs:3410`) plus `UNAVAILABLE` on the span (`main.rs:3416`) |
| gRPC body admission limits (raw cap, single frame) | middleware | yes | refusals surface as `rpc.grpc.status_code` 8/3 and `maple.ingest.reject_reason` via `record_grpc_outcome` |

</details>

## Maple review 🟢 **Confidence 8/10** · likely safe to merge Held at 8 because a warning is open. 1 warning −1 · tests covered · risk medium · 2/2 new units observable Adds gzip, the HTTP path's raw/decoded body limits, the gateway deadline and a one-message guard to the OTLP/gRPC gateway, and wires port 4317 through the ALB. The Rust path is sound and tested; only the new shutdown join needs bounding before merge. - `grpc_service` handlers accept gzip and use `INGEST_MAX_DECODED_BODY_BYTES` as tonic's message limit - `limit_grpc_body` caps the raw frame and `SingleGrpcFrame` refuses a second message - `grpc_admission` enforces `INGEST_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECS` and answers `UNAVAILABLE` - Shutdown now awaits the gRPC server before the WAL drain ### Before merge - [ ] **Infra** · Check every environment has what this config now expects · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/0a453cdeb60d9285aa45760a63ece0e8065d0b42/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts) - [ ] **Manual** · Turn on Network → gRPC for the maple.dev and EU Cloudflare zones, or every gRPC export is a 403 - [ ] **Manual** · Confirm the `TargetGroup-4317-http-grpc` health check passes and its rule is attached to the 443 listener after the first prd deploy ### Findings
🟠 Warning · F2 · grpc_server.await blocks the WAL drain when axum::serve returns an error correctness · [`apps/ingest/src/main.rs:3214-3217`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/0a453cdeb60d9285aa45760a63ece0e8065d0b42/apps/ingest/src/main.rs#L3214-L3217) `run_grpc_server` only returns once `serve_with_shutdown` sees a shutdown signal, so when `axum::serve` returns `Err` (an accept error) without one, the join at `main.rs:3216` never completes: main never reaches the drain, `flush_wal_to_object_store` and the `Ingest server failed` line at `main.rs:3278` never run, and the task lingers until someone sends SIGTERM. Before this hunk the same failure drained the WAL and called `exit(1)`. ``` // Its exports must land in the WAL before the drain below reads it. A failed // `axum::serve` returns without a shutdown signal, and the gRPC server only // stops on one, so do not block the drain on it. if let Some(grpc_server) = grpc_server { if serve_result.is_err() { grpc_server.abort(); } else { drop(grpc_server.await); } } ```
### Production impact
Telemetry this change adds and removes (1) - ➕ attribute `deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds` · `patches/@alchemy.run%2Faws@2.0.0-beta.84.patch:183`
What was checked - `SingleGrpcFrame` traced for split headers, zero-length frames and trailing bytes; it always advances and only refuses past the first frame - Refusal codes 3/8/14 classify as `Ok`, `Ok` and `Error` through `grpc_otel_status_for_rejection` (`main.rs:2344`) - The `Limited` cap plus tonic's decoded limit mirror the HTTP path's `max_request_body_bytes`/`max_decoded_body_bytes` pair
Observability coverage: 2 of 2 changes observable | Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | OTLP/gRPC Export on the three collector services | inbound RPC | yes | `grpc_server_span` (main.rs:3372) with rpc semconv, outcome recorded by `record_grpc_outcome` (main.rs:3419) | | gRPC body-cap, second-frame and deadline refusals | error path | yes | `rpc.grpc.status_code`, `maple.ingest.reject_reason`, `ingest_request_timeouts_total` and a `warn!` with `path` (main.rs:3410-3417) |
`0a453cd` · Updated on every push. Reply "won't fix" to dismiss a finding, or mention @maple-review-bot to ask about one.

## Maple review

🟢 **Confidence 10/10** · safe to merge
The F2 fix aborts the gRPC task on a failed `axum::serve`, and the new limit and deadline paths are pinned by Rust tests; the infra diff was reviewed in earlier rounds, not re-read here.
<sub>no findings · tests covered · risk medium · 1/1 new units observable</sub>

The OTLP/gRPC gateway now accepts gzip, enforces the HTTP path's raw/decoded body limits and deadline inside admission, and no longer blocks the WAL drain when `axum::serve` fails. Safe to merge once the Cloudflare zone gRPC toggle is flipped.

- `grpc_server` is aborted when `axum::serve` returns `Err`, so the WAL drain still runs
- `grpc_router` accepts gzip and raises the tonic message limit to the decoded ceiling
- `limit_grpc_body` wraps the body in `Limited` plus `SingleGrpcFrame`
- `grpc_admission` enforces `request_timeout` and answers `Unavailable`

### Before merge

- [ ] **Infra** · Check every environment has what this config now expects · [`apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts`](https://github.com/MapleTechLabs/maple/blob/fd705ba1e8f1906dfee5e8f07e95e7f2b6d7d190/apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts) <!-- ms:infra:apps/ingest/alchemy.run.ts -->
- [ ] **Manual** · Turn on gRPC in the Cloudflare zone for maple.dev (Network → gRPC), or clients get 403 on 443 <!-- ms:manual:turn-on-grpc-for-the-maple-dev-and-eu-cloudflare-zone-in-the-dashboard-6f301464 -->

### Fixed since the last review

- ✅ ~~F2 · `grpc_server.await` blocks the WAL drain when `axum::serve` returns an error~~

### Production impact

<details><summary>Telemetry this change adds and removes (1)</summary>

- ➕ attribute `deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds` · `patches/@alchemy.run%2Faws@2.0.0-beta.84.patch:183`

</details>

<details><summary>What was checked</summary>

- F2 fixed: `serve_result.is_err()` aborts the gRPC task before `drain_wal` (`main.rs:3216`)
- `SingleGrpcFrame::check` refuses any byte past the first frame's body (`main.rs:3475`)
- Deadline wraps admission plus the tonic call and `record_grpc_outcome` runs on the timeout response (`main.rs:3409`-`3424`)

</details>

<details><summary>Observability coverage: 1 of 1 changes observable</summary>

| Change | Kind | Observable | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| OTLP/gRPC export (Trace/Logs/Metrics `Export`) | inbound gRPC entrypoint | yes | `grpc_server_span` at apps/ingest/src/main.rs:3377, `record_grpc_outcome` at 3424 including the new UNAVAILABLE timeout branch |

</details>
